 Follow Todd Chrisley Opens Up About Being an Escort at 18 Before Becoming an Ex-Convict
 Clara Awuse Fri, October 30, 2026 at 4:22 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Curtis Hilbun / AFF-USA.COM / MEGA Todd Chrisley is revealing a surprising chapter from his past.
 The Chrisley Knows Best alum, 57, opened up about working as an escort when he was 18 during an appearance on Bunnie Xo 's Dumb Blonde podcast on Thursday, October 29, TV Insider reported.
 "I was an escort when I was 18 in Los Angeles," Todd said. "I left South Carolina when I was 17. It's in my book that's coming out."
 Todd explained that he didn't go looking for the work. Instead, it began while he was waiting tables at the original Cheesecake Factory in Marina del Rey, California.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "I remember waiting the tables this night, and there were, like, six or seven good-looking women," he recalled.
 At the end of the night, Todd said he received an $800 tip and was approached by a limousine driver. "He said, 'My lady would like to speak with you. She said you were their server this evening,'" Todd shared.
 The woman, who was 38, offered to drive him home, but Todd said she never dropped him off, and the night "turned into a very quick encounter."
 He began seeing the woman, whom he didn't name, but later discovered she was married, which left him "devastated." Todd ended the relationship but went on to see another woman, adding, "I was a magnet to that."
 Advertisement Advertisement Todd has been married to his wife, Julie Chrisley , since 1996. Before that, he was married to his high school sweetheart, Teresa Terry , from 1990 until their 1996 divorce. Todd shares two children with Terry: daughter Lindsie Chrisley , 37, and son Kyle Chrisley , 35. Both have been estranged from their dad at times over the years, and Lindsie said in March 2025 that she hadn't seen Todd "in quite some time."
 Todd and Julie share three children: Chase , 30, Savannah , 29, and Grayson , 20. They also legally adopted Kyle's daughter, Chloe . Earlier this week, Savannah announced she's expecting her first child with fiancé Jason Galanis .
 In 2022, Todd and Julie were convicted of bank and tax fraud and sentenced to a combined 19 years in prison. They spent just over two years behind bars before President Donald Trump pardoned them on May 27, 2025.
 Earlier this month, the couple were reportedly in trouble with the IRS again after allegedly failing to pay more than $1.5 million in federal taxes.
